scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @aion/privacy-boundary && npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js" "test/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/contracts.test.js" "dist-test/test/bootstrap.test.js"
scripts.test:persistence: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/file-repository.test.js"
scripts.test:cli: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @aion/privacy-boundary && node --test --test-reporter=tap "test/cli.test.mjs" "test/architecture-boundary.test.mjs"
